input.summary: Cure illusory cap basis (defined "Fees" = USD 12,000 implementation fee under the first Order Form), anchor the 12-month lookback to the claim, and put Customer's payment obligations as a whole outside capped damages.
input.comment: [Playbook] "Fees" is defined as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory; we reset it at the greater of lowercase fees paid or payable under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. We also confirm that Customer's obligations to pay amounts due are not damages subject to the cap; indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security remain uncapped as Excluded Claims.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's obligations to pay amounts due under this Agreement and any Order Form are not damages and are not limited by this Section.
